claims: The Artemis II crew consists of four astronauts.
The Artemis II crew is scheduled for a 10-day mission around the Moon.
Reid Wiseman is the NASA Commander of the Artemis II crew.
Victor Glover is the NASA Pilot of the Artemis II crew.
Victor Glover is the first Black person to fly to the Moon.
Christina Koch is the NASA Mission Specialist of the Artemis II crew.
Christina Koch is the first woman to fly to the Moon.
Jeremy Hansen is the Canadian Space Agency (CSA) Mission Specialist of the Artemis II crew.
Reid Wiseman is a veteran Navy aviator.
Reid Wiseman previously served on the International Space Station (ISS).
Victor Glover is a Navy aviator.
Victor Glover piloted the SpaceX Crew-1 mission.
Christina Koch holds the record for the longest single flight by a female astronaut.
Jeremy Hansen is a CSA astronaut.
Jeremy Hansen is making his first spaceflight.
Jeremy Hansen is the first non-U.S. citizen to fly to the Moon.
Artemis II is scheduled to launch on the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
Artemis II is the first crewed mission to return to the vicinity of the Moon since 1972.
